title: MAPKeeper 301: Atebimetinib plus Gemcitabine/nab-Paclitaxel in Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
official: A Phase 3 Randomized, Open-Label Study of Atebimetinib in Combination with the Modified Gemcitabine and nab-Paclitaxel Regimen Versus the Standard Gemcitabine and nab-Paclitaxel Regimen for the Treatment of Patients with Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Cancer (MAPKeeper 301)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the overall survival (OS) of atebimetinib in combination with modified gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (mGnP) versus gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (GnP)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant must be ≥18 years of age, at the time of signing the informed consent.
2. Participant must have confirmed diagnosis according to American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) staging as follows: Metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma at least 12 weeks prior to screening
3. Participant must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
4. Participants must be treatment naive as follows: First-line PDAC participants will have received no previous systemic anti-cancer therapy
5. Participants must have evidence of measurable disease (at least one target lesion) per RECIST v1.1 criteria
6. Participants must have adequate organ function, hepatic function, coagulation studies and protocol determined clinical laboratory values
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participant has squamous, adenosquamous, neuroendocrine (carcinoid, islet cell) or acinar pancreatic carcinoma.
2. Participants with only localized advanced disease.
3. Symptomatic, untreated, or actively progressing known central nervous system (CNS) metastases
4. Inability to swallow oral medications
